sources.label: My attempt at Morphe patches.
sources.author: Neil
patch_list: Adds options in Morphe Settings to hide the News, Scores, Favorites and Bet tabs. Leagues is always shown.
Adds options in Morphe Settings to hide individual top tabs on game and league screens.
Adds options in Morphe Settings to hide the league chips and the Spotlight section on the Leagues tab.
Adds options in Morphe Settings to hide blocks on a game's Scorecast tab, such as Game News and Odds.
Adds an option in Morphe Settings (on by default) to keep the classic game screen if theScore turns on its redesigned one, so the game tab and Scorecast patches keep working.
Removes ads everywhere: the startup splash, banners and large ads on every screen, sponsor ads, full-screen ads and video ads.
